officialText:
Section 700.31 – Revise Section 700.31 to read as follows:

700.31 Ground Fault Protection of Equipment. The alternate source for emergency systems shall not be permitted to have ground fault protection for equipment with automatic disconnecting means. Ground fault indication of the emergency source shall be provided pursuant to 700.6(D).
